name: Decimal expansion of Sum_{n >= 1} sigma_4(n)/n!.
comment: This constant's irrationality was conjectured by Erdős and Kac in 1953 and proved by Pratt in 2022.
link: Paul Erdős and Mark Kac, Problem 4518, American Mathematical Monthly, Vol. 60, No. 1 (1953), p. 47.
Kyle Pratt, The irrationality of a divisor function series of Erdős and Kac, arXiv preprint, arXiv:2209.11124 [math.NT], 2022.
author: _Charles R Greathouse IV_, Dec 14 2022
